skill.name: knowledge-work-design
skill.description: Use when running design workflows — critique, design-system management, UX writing, accessibility audits, research synthesis, and dev handoff — standalone or connected to Figma.
whenToUse: Getting structured design feedback on usability, visual hierarchy, and consistency
Auditing, documenting, or extending a design system — components, tokens, patterns
Generating developer handoff specs — measurements, tokens, states, and edge cases
Running a WCAG accessibility audit for contrast, screen reader, and keyboard navigation

keyConcepts.explanation: Commands are explicit slash workflows (/critique, /design-system, /handoff, /ux-copy, /accessibility, /research-synthesis); skills are domain knowledge Claude applies automatically.
Evaluates designs for usability, visual hierarchy, consistency, and adherence to design principles, backing the /critique command.
Manages design tokens, component libraries, and pattern documentation behind the /design-system command.
Audits designs and code for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, driving the /accessibility workflow.
ux-writing produces clear, brand-aligned microcopy; user-research plans, conducts, and synthesizes interviews, surveys, and usability tests.
Creates comprehensive developer handoff documentation from designs, behind the /handoff command.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also works in Claude Code
Commands run standalone from a screenshot or description but are supercharged when you connect Figma
It's a plugin bundling seven skills, not a single skill; skills fire automatically while commands are invoked explicitly
/critique needs a Figma link, screenshot, or description — it won't invent the design under review
accessibility-review targets WCAG 2.1 AA specifically, not arbitrary or custom compliance levels
